title: BusinessPackPayload
description:
The payload of a `business_pack` artifact: a composition pack
(`packKind: "composition"`, or omitted by IR `0.1` packs; `provides`,
`artifacts`), an ontology pack (`packKind: "ontology"`; `sources`,
`terms`, `mappings`, `shapes`) or a link pack (`packKind: "link"`;
`fromPack`, `toPack`, `correspondences`, `residuals`).

CompositionPackKind.description: The only `packKind` literal of a composition pack.

CompositionPackRoot.description: A composition pack: the exact artifact versions that ship together.

artifacts.description: Non-empty list of the pack's artifacts.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

packKind.description: Omitted by IR `0.1` composition packs; newly authored packs emit it.

CorrespondenceRelation.description: How a source term relates to its target terms.

oneOf.description: Every instance of the source term is an instance of the target term.
Every instance of the target term is an instance of the source term.
The source term's value is a function of the target terms.

IrVersion01.description:
The only IR `0.1` version literal of the connector, widget, customization,
policy, derived, and setting roots and of ontology business packs.

LinkResidual.description: A source term the link does not map.

LinkedPack.description: One linked pack, pinned by its artifact id and exact artifact version.

OntologyLinkKind.description: The only `packKind` literal of a link pack.

OntologyLinkRoot.description:
A link pack: checked correspondences from the terms of one ontology pack
(`fromPack`) to the terms of another (`toPack`). Every active term of the
source pack is accounted for, by a correspondence or a residual
(registry rule).

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

fromPack.description: The pack whose terms are mapped.

residuals.description: Source terms with no correspondence, and why.

toPack.description: The pack the terms map into.

OntologyMapping.description: A reviewed mapping from a Norn term to an external IRI of a pinned source.

ratifiedAt.description:
When the mapping was ratified: a UTC RFC 3339 string, required on
`exact_match` mappings and optional on the other relations (checker
rule).

ratifiedBy.description:
Who ratified the mapping: a non-empty string, required on
`exact_match` mappings and optional on the other relations (checker
rule).

supersededByMappingId.description: Names a mapping of the same term and source in the pack.

OntologyPackKind.description: The only `packKind` literal of an ontology pack.

OntologyPackRoot.description: An ontology pack: a closed-world, semantic-only ontology profile.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

mappings.description: Non-empty; reviewed mappings from terms to external IRIs.

shapes.description: Non-empty; one closed promotion shape per active shaped term.

OntologyShape.description: A closed promotion shape for one active term.

OntologyShapeField.description: One field of an ontology shape.

OntologySource.description: A pinned upstream source release of an ontology pack.

files.description:
Required (non-empty) for vendored sources. A source the pack imports
or maps from is content-pinned: by these hashes or by a commit or
hash in `releaseId` (checker rule).

importMode.description: How the pack uses the source (norn#56 source manifest).

importer.description:
The importer that read the source. Required for `import` (checker
rule); a reviewed hand mapping has none.

releaseId.description: A strict immutable version, dated-standard release, or content pin.

sourceId.description: In the lowercase `source.*` namespace, unique within the pack.

OntologySourceFile.description:
A hash-pinned file of a source: a repository path for vendored files,
or the absolute HTTPS URL of the pinned bytes otherwise.

parentTermId.description: Resolves within the pack to a compatible, acyclic parent.

supersededBy.description: Required exactly on `superseded` terms; names an active term.

termId.description: An opaque lowercase `norn.*` identifier, unique within the pack.

OntologyTermKind.description:
What an ontology term denotes. `class`, `value_object` and
`concept_scheme_root` terms take one closed promotion shape; `property`,
`action` and `predicate` terms are vocabulary handles and take none.

oneOf.description: A business operation on its domain class (posting an invoice).
A condition over canon state, such as an admission refusal.

OntologyTermStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an ontology term.

PackArtifactKind.description: Artifact kinds a composition pack may contain (not `derived`).

oneOf.description: A discovered source schema included in a mapping pack.

PackArtifactRef.description: One exact artifact version in a composition pack.

ResidualReason.description: Why a source term has no correspondence (norn-platform#2986).

oneOf.description: Detail specific to the source system; the canon drops it.
The target lacks a term for it; the canon should grow one.

SemanticAuthority.description: Ontology terms are semantic only: they never grant mutation authority.

ShapeValueType.description: Value types of an ontology shape field.

SourceImportMode.description:
How a pack uses one of its sources.

`import` takes content into the pack's own terms, so its licence must
permit redistribution. `map_only` only maps Norn terms to the source; no
source content enters the pack (the clean-room mode for copyleft and
API-terms sources). `study_only` informs review; no mapping may cite it.

SourceImporter.description: The importer that read a source: an id and its strict version.

SourceRedistribution.description: Whether a source is only referenced or vendored into the repository.

TermCorrespondence.description: One checked correspondence from a source-pack term to target-pack terms.

evidenceRefs.description:
Non-empty; at least one names a mapped source of `fromPack`'s
manifest (`source.*`), the others are absolute HTTPS IRIs.

rulingRef.description: The ruling that settled a divergence this correspondence resolves.

toTermIds.description: Active terms of `toPack`: exactly one, or one or more for `derived`.

transformRef.description:
The `mapping` artifact that executes a `derived` correspondence, when
one exists. The correspondence is semantic either way.

WholeNumber.description:
A non-negative integral JSON number.

IR JSON numbers are binary64 ([`JsonValue::Number`]), so a count written
as `3` and one decoded as `3.0` are the same value. This accepts any
integral, non-negative number up to 2^53 (the exact-integer range of
binary64), matching the validators' `fract() == 0.0` checks; each member's
lower bound stays a checker rule.
